en: Helium gas is about seven times less dense than the air we breathe, making helium balloons float.
When liquid water freezes into solid ice, it expands in volume by approximately nine percent.
Ocean water contains about 35 grams of dissolved salt for every one liter of liquid.
The air we breathe is a mixture containing roughly 78 percent nitrogen and 21 percent oxygen.
Osmium is the densest natural element, weighing about twice as much as lead for the exact same volume.
Solid gallium melts at 29.76 degrees Celsius, which is cooler than normal human body temperature.
The Sun is composed of plasma, a superheated state of matter making up over 99 percent of its mass.
Bronze is a solid metal mixture typically made of 88 percent copper and 12 percent tin.
A single drop of water contains roughly 1.5 sextillion molecules, which is a one followed by 21 zeros.
Liquid nitrogen boils at minus 196 degrees Celsius, making it much colder than freezing liquid water.
Diamond is the hardest natural material on Earth, scoring a perfect 10 on the Mohs hardness scale.
Mixing two parts cornstarch with one part water creates a non-Newtonian fluid that acts solid when struck.
